request.purpose: Check whether alcohol and residual_sugar have marginal overlap between colors, then estimate within-color alcohol-by-sugar associations in a prespecified overlap region, both unadjusted and adjusted for the other measured chemical variables. Treat this as an exploratory diagnostic, not confirmation; use row bootstrap intervals with the dependence limitation stated.
request.model_spec: For each color, restrict to the intersection of the two colors' marginal 5th–95th percentile ranges for alcohol and residual_sugar. Center and scale alcohol and residual_sugar within that restricted color subset. Fit ordinary least squares to quality with alcohol, residual_sugar, their product, and, in the adjusted model, all other continuous chemistry columns. Bootstrap rows within color 200 times for percentile intervals on the interaction coefficient. Report retained row counts, overlap bounds, coefficients and intervals, and make no causal claim. OLS is a diagnostic for the numeric score; it does not resolve ordinal-scale sensitivity or unknown clustering.
